design.controls: Originals, local gain, filter and noise, constant offsets, synchronized picture/sound observations, whole-track dubbing from another retained speaker and a rendered cut between synchronized scenes.
design.input: 6.4 s, 480 x 360 H.264 at 25 fps, 16 kHz mono PCM with fixed resampling endpoints. Two frozen offsets per person.
design.method: Eight regularized canonical correlation directions from same-clock speech. Compare one constant offset with one temporary offset using identical observed ticks and both neighboring flanks within one shot.
design.pass: Add at least four correct locations spanning three held people. Allow at most two extra control flags and two extra misplaced edits, with zero extra whole-track, synchronized, dubbed or camera-cut flags.
design.point: Strict excess above the largest ordinary response on four separate calibration people plus 0.02, with a 0.10 floor. Freeze before held scoring.
design.utility: At least 0.40 temporal intersection over union on the soundtrack clock and a signed offset within 80 ms of the known edit.
